mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_risk_control_action ( id, symbol, action_type, is_active, trigger_source, trigger_reason, hedge_log_id, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id}, #{symbol}, #{actionTypeCode}, 1, #{triggerSource}, #{triggerReason}, #{hedgeLogId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_risk_control_action WHERE symbol <=> #{symbol} AND action_type = #{actionTypeCode} AND trigger_source = #{triggerSource} AND is_active = 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, action_type, is_active, trigger_source, trigger_reason, hedge_log_id, created_at, updated_at FROM t_risk_control_action WHERE is_active = 1 AND symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY action_type DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_risk_control_action WHERE is_active = 1 AND symbol IS NULL AND action_type = 4

ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
